subject: Wraning message when trying to fit a sem model

messages.author: 1d1c683ff9ca2408
messages.subject: Wraning message when trying to fit a sem model
parts:
Hi,

I am a PhD student and i work on quality of life (QoL) in children. I want to use the SEM model to explore the relations among sociodemographic, medical et psychosocial variables on QoL I get this warning message when il fit my first model:

Warning message:
In lavaan::lavaan(model = model0, data = novE, model.type = "sem",  :
  lavaan WARNING: syntax contains parameters involving exogenous covariates; switching to fixed.x = FALSE


Can i have any help?


thanks

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Wraning message when trying to fit a sem model
parts: Can i have any help?

That is the help.  Add the argument fixed.x=FALSE to your syntax if you want to place constraints on exogenous parameters.  However, if you want to allow all the exogenous variables to covary, you don't have to specify those parameters in your syntax.  sem() will just take their observed values from the data, simplifying the estimation.
